metadata.sql:
SELECT 
    w.driver_name,
    w.driver_code,
    w.constructor,
    w.finish_time,
    w.year,
    w.grand_prix,
    ROUND((p2.finish_ms - w.finish_ms) / 1000.0, 3) AS winning_margin_s
FROM v_race_results w
JOIN v_race_results p2 ON w.race_id = p2.race_id
WHERE w.year = 2021
  AND ((lower(w.grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(w.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(w.grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(w.circuit_country) = 'brazil') OR lower(w.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR (lower(w.grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(w.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(w.grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(w.circuit_country) = 'brazil'))
  AND w.position = 1
  AND p2.position = 2
  AND w.finish_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p2.finish_ms IS NOT NULL
metadata.chart_title: Who won the 2021 Brazilian Grand Prix and what was the winning margin over P2?
